intro_nocase.text: MP Officer: Where do you think you’re heading all geared up like that?
MP Officer: No gear past this checkpoint.
MP Officer: Relax! You won’t need that on the other side.
MP Officer: Stay close, follow my instructions precisely, unless you wanna end up in a body bag.
MP Officer: You’ll have to wait your turn for evac.

MP Officer: This is a restricted area under martial law. Keep your nose out!
MP Officer: We’re going inside now. Eyes forward, don’t ask questions.
MP Officer: Follow the instructions to the letter. Otherwise we won’t go easy on you.
MP Officer: Alright, that’s your stop. Stay here.
